WITH pascola_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-89.828792 36.264794, -89.82982 36.264803, -89.829838 36.269858, -89.827931 36.269835, -89.82259 36.269889, -89.821704 36.269877, -89.822016 36.266228, -89.822104 36.264782, -89.822111 36.264463, -89.826258 36.26447, -89.826262 36.264746, -89.828792 36.264794))')::geometry AS geom
)
SELECT MIN(rast_val) AS min_elevation
FROM (
  SELECT ST_Value(r.rast, 1, p.geom) AS rast_val
  FROM pascola_geom p
  JOIN public.dem_us r
    ON ST_Intersects(r.rast::geography, p.geom)
  WHERE ST_Clip(r.rast, 1, p.geom, TRUE) IS NOT NULL
) sub;
